articles.title: Melting Himalayan Glacier Triggers Deadly Floods on Nepal-China Border
articles.summary: A massive glacier high in the Himalayas partially collapsed on 26 August 2026, sending a wall of ice, rock and mud rushing down into the Nepal-China border region at enormous speed. The disaster destroyed the Gyirong border crossing and swept away entire villages along a 72-kilometre stretch of the Trishuli River. More than 1,000 people in Nepal have been confirmed dead, while over 3,900 remain missing. Scientists believe that rising temperatures caused by climate change weakened the glacier before it broke apart. Rescue teams have struggled to reach survivors because floods destroyed most roads. The United Nations sent emergency workers and supplies to help affected communities.

lv1: Where did the glacier collapse that caused the floods? (冰川在哪裡崩塌，引發了洪災？)
How many people are confirmed to have died in Nepal as a result of the floods? (尼泊爾有多少人確認在洪災中遇難？)
lv2: Why did rescue teams find it so difficult to reach people affected by the floods? (為什麼救援隊伍難以抵達受洪災影響的人群？)
How might rising global temperatures have contributed to this disaster? (全球氣溫上升如何可能促成了這場災難？)
lv3: Who should be responsible for helping communities recover from climate-related disasters like this — local governments, wealthier nations, or international organisations? Why? (誰應該負責幫助社區從氣候相關災難中恢復——當地政府、富裕國家還是國際組織？為什麼？)

Some scientists say early warning systems could have saved lives, but they did not work effectively here. Should countries be legally required to install and maintain such systems in high-risk areas? (部分科學家認為早期預警系統本可拯救生命，但此次未能有效運作。各國是否應在法律上被要求在高風險地區安裝並維護此類系統？)

articles.title: Hong Kong Schools See Fewer Primary One Classes as Student Numbers Keep Falling
articles.summary: Hong Kong's public schools are opening fewer Primary One classes this academic year. The total number of such classes across the city has dropped from 1,558 in the 2025–26 school year to 1,432 in 2026–27 — a fall of over 120 classes. This decline is linked to a drop in the number of young children in the city, as Hong Kong's birth rate has been falling for many years. Fewer children means schools need fewer classes, and some schools may eventually have to merge or close. Education experts say the government should plan carefully to make sure every child still receives a quality education, even as the student population shrinks.

lv1: How many Primary One classes are there in Hong Kong's public schools in 2026–27? (2026至27學年，香港公營學校共有多少個小一班？)
Did the number of Primary One classes go up or down compared to last year? (與去年相比，小一班的數目是增加還是減少了？)
lv2: Why might a falling birth rate lead to schools having to close or merge? (出生率下降為何可能導致學校需要合併或關閉？)
How could a drop in the number of students affect the quality of education that children receive? (學生人數減少會如何影響兒童所接受的教育質素？)
lv3: If a school in your neighbourhood had to close because of falling student numbers, what do you think should happen to the students, teachers and the school building? (如果你附近的學校因學生人數下降而需要關閉，你認為學生、老師和校舍應該如何處置？)

Some people think the government should encourage families to have more children to solve this problem, while others believe it should instead focus on attracting children from other places to study in Hong Kong. Which approach do you think is better, and why? (有人認為政府應鼓勵家庭生育更多子女以解決問題，也有人認為應吸引其他地方的兒童來港就讀。你認為哪種方式更好？為什麼？)

articles.title: 習近平出席上海合作組織峰會　與多國領袖會面
articles.summary: 國家主席習近平於8月30日至9月3日前往吉爾吉斯首都比什凱克，出席上海合作組織（上合組織）峰會。上合組織由中國、俄羅斯及多個中亞國家組成，成員國定期開會商討安全、經濟及區域合作等議題。習近平在峰會期間與多位國家領導人舉行雙邊會談，就地區局勢及合作事宜交換意見。分析人士指，今次峰會有助加強成員國之間的聯繫，並展示中國在中亞地區的影響力與外交活躍度。

lv1: 上海合作組織峰會今次在哪個城市舉行？
習近平出席今次峰會共歷時多少天？
lv2: 上海合作組織的主要目的是什麼？各成員國為何重視定期舉行峰會？
中國積極參與上合組織活動，對中國的外交地位有什麼影響？
lv3: 有人認為像上合組織這類以地區大國為主導的國際組織，有助維護區域穩定；也有人認為這類組織可能令小國受大國影響。你認為這類國際組織對小成員國是利多於弊，還是弊多於利？
中國近年積極在中亞地區加強外交及經濟影響力。你認為這對香港以至亞洲整體的發展有什麼潛在的機遇或挑戰？

articles.title: 尼泊爾中國邊境洪災逾千死　科學家指冰川融化釀禍
articles.summary: 今年8月26日，喜馬拉雅山脈一段冰川突然崩塌，引發大規模洪水及泥石流，重創尼泊爾與中國西藏邊境地區。洪水沿特里蘇利河流域蔓延，摧毀多條村莊及吉隆口岸等基礎設施。尼泊爾境內死亡人數已超過一千人，仍有近四千人下落不明。科學家指出，全球暖化導致高山冰川加速融化，是今次災難的主要成因之一，警告類似事故日後或更頻繁發生。聯合國緊急調派救援人員及物資協助當地災民。

lv1: 今次洪災的起因是什麼？
災難發生在哪條山脈附近？
lv2: 為什麼全球暖化會令高山洪災的風險增加？
今次洪災對尼泊爾邊境社區造成了哪些影響？
lv3: 科學家警告氣候變化令天災更頻繁，但減少溫室氣體排放需要各國共同努力。你認為各國應如何分擔責任，才算公平合理？
若你是政府官員，你會優先採取哪些措施來減低類似天災對社區造成的傷亡？請列舉並解釋你的理由。
